title: Login page times out behind the office proxy
body: Since the proxy change, the login page spins for thirty seconds and then shows a blank screen. Other pages load. Reproduced on two laptops.

title: Password reset email arrives twice
body: Every reset request sends two emails with different links. Only the second link works, which confuses people.

title: Add a dark theme to the settings page
body: The settings page ignores the system theme. Add a dark variant that follows it.

title: Session cookie is not cleared on logout
body: After logout the session cookie stays in the browser until it expires. A second user on the same machine is logged in as the first.

title: Export to CSV drops the last row
body: The CSV export of the report table always misses its last row.

title: Single sign-on button missing on mobile
body: On screens narrower than 400 pixels the single sign-on button is hidden under the footer.

title: Login fails for names with an apostrophe
body: A user name with an apostrophe returns an error 500 on login.

title: Rate limit on the search endpoint is too low
body: The search endpoint allows ten requests a minute, and the dashboard makes twelve on load.
